# JagoanCV

> JagoanCV is a free, local-first web application for building CVs and cover letters, reviewing transparent ATS-readiness guidance, and exporting text-based PDFs.

Canonical site: https://jagoancv.pages.dev/

## Public pages

- [Bahasa Indonesia](https://jagoancv.pages.dev/): Primary Indonesian landing page.
- [English](https://jagoancv.pages.dev/en/): English landing page with the same product capabilities.
- [Editor](https://jagoancv.pages.dev/editor.html): Interactive CV and cover-letter workspace. This workspace is marked `noindex,follow` and is intentionally excluded from the sitemap.

## Product capabilities

- Guided CV creation in six sections.
- Cover-letter creation in the same workspace.
- A4 preview and text-based PDF export.
- Transparent CV-readiness checks for structure, completeness, content quality, and consistency.
- Keyword coverage calculated and displayed separately from the readiness score.
- Indonesian and English interface and document languages.
- Responsive editor, preview, and check views for mobile and desktop browsers.
- Automatic local saving without an account.

## Data and privacy

CV content and job descriptions are stored in the current browser's local storage. They are not sent to a JagoanCV backend for processing. Cross-device synchronization is not available, so data remains in the browser and device where it was created.

## Important limitations

- The JagoanCV readiness score is explanatory guidance, not an official score from Workday, Greenhouse, or any other ATS vendor.
- JagoanCV does not guarantee that a CV will pass an ATS or result in an interview.
- Keyword coverage is a separate text-matching aid and is not folded into the readiness score.
- All current product features are free. The optional Saweria link is for support and does not unlock features.

## Discovery note

This `llms.txt` file is a supplemental machine-readable summary. Canonical metadata, `hreflang`, `robots.txt`, and `sitemap.xml` remain the standard discovery and indexing controls.
